notes.title: Version 3.0
notes.notes:
-Upgraded engine so I can work in dark mode

-Removed ability for employees to get sick if they are already sick
-Decreased sickness

-Fixed misaligned UI
-Fixed missing character portraits
-Fixed all employees disappearing from list
-Fixed room floor textures having different sizes
-Fixed employees getting stuck in doors

-Added new 3D models
-Added new characters
-Added party lights
-Added building placement guides
-Increased expenses
-Decreased profitability

Special thanks to Clay for making this update happen!

notes.title: Outbreak Released (New Update)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34346652/bd4c674b01b9db21437b28e84f1056e7c7c12af3.png[/img]
I hope everyone enjoys this new Coronavirus inspired update! The spread of germs is something on everyone's mind lately, so I added it into the game. Employees can spread the virus among each other, so how you design your office is going to be very important!

[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list][*]Added contagion
[*]Added virus spread
[*]Added coughing

[*]Fixed camera bug
[*]Restricted camera movement to prevent losing office
[*]Changed default camera control settings
[*]Fixed lighting bug
[*]Fixed computer lights
[*]Increased employee profitability
[*]Fixed hire button
[/list]
